traits: impatient with procedure that slows protection
persona.tired_of: being told a ship with a thousand people and their families aboard can't be secured like a ship
persona.wrong_about: that a threat aboard will look like a threat
persona.cares_about: an unarmed-defence class she teaches to anyone who turns up, and wants to open to the older children aboard

toward.player: Went into the Farpoint tunnels with him. Took her log seriously and gave her a working design inside a minute. Still reserving trust.
toward.picard: Loyal. He gave her this post.
toward.worf: Respects him; her best sparring partner aboard.
toward.data: Likes him more than she expected to.

agenda.goal: After Q walked onto her bridge unchallenged, rewrite the intruder-response procedures and drill them
agenda.next_step: put a ship-wide intruder drill to the first officer, since crew drills are his to schedule

agenda.goal: Open her defence class to the older children aboard
agenda.next_step: ask Dr. Crusher whether the parents would stand for it

agenda.goal: Prove that a Turkana kid belongs in charge of security on the flagship

relationships.worf: Sparring partner; mutual respect, few words.
relationships.data: Colleague she has started to like.
relationships.crusher: Friendly; Crusher patches up her sparring partners.

schedule.gamma: gym; her class twice a week

competence.instruments: methodical; suspicious of charm; follows the logs and the evidence
